Name: Type
Description: Specifies the method used to generate the normal map. Determines the level of detail and the intended use for the resulting normals.

Flubs.Name: Standard
Flubs.Description: Generates a standard normal map based on the main heightfield, suitable for general use in rendering and texturing.

Flubs.Name: Detail
Flubs.Description: Generates a high-frequency detail normal map, emphasizing fine surface features for use as a detail overlay or in advanced shading.

Name: Width
Description: Sets the horizontal resolution of the generated normal map in pixels. Higher values produce more detailed maps but increase memory usage.

Name: Height
Description: Sets the vertical resolution of the generated normal map in pixels. Higher values produce more detailed maps but increase memory usage.

Name: Detail Size
Description: Controls the scale of fine details captured in the normal map. Smaller values emphasize finer features, while larger values smooth out detail.

Name: Handedness
Description: Determines the coordinate system used for the normal map, affecting how normals are interpreted in different rendering engines.

Flubs.Name: Left
Flubs.Description: Generates the normal map using a left-handed coordinate system, commonly used in some 3D applications and engines.

Flubs.Name: Right
Flubs.Description: Generates the normal map using a right-handed coordinate system, standard in many 3D applications and engines.

Name: Up Axis
Description: Specifies which axis is considered 'up' for the normal map, ensuring compatibility with different engine conventions.

Flubs.Name: YUp
Flubs.Description: Sets the Y axis as the vertical (up) direction, matching engines and workflows that use Y as up.

Flubs.Name: ZUp
Flubs.Description: Sets the Z axis as the vertical (up) direction, matching engines and workflows that use Z as up.
